                  same owner's platform, so these are first-party bytes served
                  from a first-party host, not a third party's artwork.
Licence:          Reserved media, not licensed with the code; see TRADEMARKS.md.
Origin:           https://cdn.openally.ai/app-assets/v1/features/settings/profile/banners/{id}.webp
Ids:              a1–a10, b1–b10, c1–c10, plus fallback.webp (byte-identical to a1).
Fetched:          2026-08-29

These are identity tiles the person picks, not Taffy. Persist the id, never a URL.
Do not put a Grok (or any generator) mark on derivatives.

The origin above is where the bytes were fetched from, and it is the reason
this record used to read as though they were someone else's: a URL at another
product's domain looks like a third-party import whichever way it is written.
It is not one. TaffyGo operates no server (decision 0200) and will not rehost
these anywhere — the committed WebP is the only copy the product reads, and the
checksums below are the reviewable link to it.
